info.name: ByProduct API
info.description:
Every ByProduct endpoint, in the order the demo runs.

Before you start:
1. python manage.py seed_demo (fresh demo data: the demo story expects it).
2. python manage.py runserver
3. Set the collection variable demo_password to your DEMO_PASSWORD.
4. Run the folders in order (Collection Runner, or one by one). The log-in requests save {{moto_access}}, {{moto_refresh}} and {{doors_access}} for the rest.

Running it changes the data (needs, pickups, kilos reused). Run seed_demo again to start fresh.

item.name: Moto posts 1,200 kg of sawdust within 10 km

exec: pm.test("nearest is Kariobangi Doors and Frames", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().suggestions[0].seller.name).to.eql("Kariobangi Doors and Frames"));
pm.test("the 5th is Ngara Sofa Makers", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().pickups[4].seller.name).to.eql("Ngara Sofa Makers"));
pm.test("explains why", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Only the seller can accept."));
